description: This line plot, titled "Finetuning for different r, Gazeta," illustrates how the ROUGE-1 score varies with the logarithmic value of r for four different fine-tuning methods applied to the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis represents log r, plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents ROUGE-1 score, plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. Four distinct lines are shown: the red line with circular markers represents T5 + LoRA, starting at approximately 23.5 and ending at around 24.5; the purple line with circular markers represents MBart + LoRA, starting at 5, dipping to 2 before rising to approximately 23.5; the green line with circular markers represents T5 + AdaLoRA, starting at approximately 23.5 and rising steadily to around 30.2; and the gold line with circular markers represents MBart + AdaLoRA, starting at 5, rising sharply to approximately 31.5, and then leveling off near 33.5.
